title: Avoid English-only remote model for non-English transcription
description: Config can have language=nl while remote_server.model remains an English-only model such as medium.en. Remote transcription then sends Dutch audio to an English-only model and produces English gibberish. Make remote model selection strip .en for non-English languages and keep language/model config coherent.
close_reason: Fixed by normalizing English-only local, fallback, and remote model names whenever language is non-English; remote requests now use the effective multilingual remote model.

title: Investigate truncated long transcription output
description: An approximately 90 minute transcribe session stopped at /home/sander/Documents/Transcripts/sprint-start-20260511-124532.txt, but only produced a ~25 KB incomplete transcript. Need root cause and fix for long-session transcription truncation.
close_reason: Fixed long-form transcription finalization to process queued chunks sequentially and wait for all pending chunks before showing save dialog; also fixed remote requests to use the configured remote model. Investigation found saved temp file matched output, 97 chunks/26339 chars were written, 2 chunks failed, and the remote endpoint was refusing connections so the session used local CPU fallback.

title: Add support for microsoft/mai-transcribe-2 via OpenRouter
description: Add support for microsoft/mai-transcribe-2 over OpenRouter /audio/transcriptions API, checking support for pre-text (prompt) and language filters.
close_reason: Added support for microsoft/mai-transcribe-2 via OpenRouter, verified language filters and prompt context handling.

title: Remember model per language in context menu
description: Context menu should remember the last selected transcription model per language, so English can restore distil-large-v3 and Dutch can restore the OpenAI large model when switching languages.
close_reason: Added per-language model preferences so switching languages restores each language's last selected context-menu model.

title: Restore remote transcription service availability
description: Remote service is reachable but CUDA model switching can OOM. Logs show service cached distil-large-v3 and medium.en, then switching Dutch traffic to multilingual medium evicted only distil-large-v3 and tried to load medium while medium.en remained resident, causing CUDA out of memory and client failures.
notes: 2026-05-13: Patched whisper_server.py to evict CUDA models before loading a different model and copied the patched script to the remote SMB share, but could not restart the Windows service because remote execution authorization was denied. Current live service remains in CUDA OOM state until restarted. Temporarily disabled remote_server.enabled in local config so Dutch dictation uses local multilingual model instead of showing OOM notifications.
